I'm reflecting on the discard decision. Thrill of Possibility has the advantage of card selection—it lets me pitch a dead card now to potentially draw into something better later. But Adventuring Gear is genuinely weak: it costs 1 to cast and 1 to equip, only providing a temporary +2/+2 boost that disappears at turn's end. Since landfalls are already occupied with Expedition triggers and casting Rampaging Baloths requires 6 mana (4GG), spending two mana on an equipment that might not even connect feels inefficient. The Gear's value diminishes if my opponent can block or remove the equipped creature before combat. It's a card I'd rather see in my library than my hand right now.

Examining my curve more carefully: turn 1 Expedition, turn 2 nothing, turn 3 land + counter, turn 4 land + counter, turn 5 land + counter + crack Expedition for two lands = 7 mana available on turn 6 to cast Baloths. Every mana spent on Adventuring Gear delays this sequence. Even if I draw it naturally next turn, that's preferable to having it clogging my hand now. The Thrill of Possibility at least preserves my ability to filter cards while maintaining the necessary land count for my combo turn.

Looking at my current eight-card hand, I need to make a cut. The Forest and Mountain are essential for hitting my land drops and Expedition triggers. Rampaging Baloths, Snapping Gnarlid, Chandra's Pyreling, and Wildfire Elemental are my core threats. That leaves Adventuring Gear and Thrill of Possibility as the weakest options. Thrill requires spending mana and a card for card selection, which feels redundant when my curve is already tight. Adventuring Gear offers marginal upside with landfall synergy but costs two mana total for a temporary effect. Given that my plan revolves around deploying creatures and triggering Expedition, I'd rather trim the equipment and keep the filtering option available for later.

Actually, reconsidering Thrill of Possibility—it's card disadvantage. Spending two cards to draw two means I'm breaking even, not advancing my position. I'd rather have a threat or mana source in hand. The Gear at least presents a must-answer threat once equipped, and the +2/+2 bonus works well with landfall strategies. Dropping Thrill leaves me with more meaningful plays.

Let me run through the sequencing: with 4 lands currently, I'll play Forest on turn 8 to hit 5, crack Expedition for two more lands to reach 7 total, then cast Rampaging Baloths. Those two fetch lands also trigger Baloths, creating two 4/4 beasts alongside my 6/6 trampler. Even if I don't draw another land, I'm still deploying Baloths on turn 8 and likely closing the game shortly after. The Gear's activation cost doesn't fit into this curve efficiently, and while Thrill might let me dig for a land if I'm desperate, it's otherwise a dead draw. I'm cutting Thrill of Possibility.

Adventuring Gear.oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, equipped creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
Equip {1} ({1}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)

Brushstrider.oracle_text: Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)

Chandra's Pyreling.oracle_text: Whenever a source you control deals noncombat damage to an opponent, this creature gets +1/+0 and gains double strike until end of turn. (It deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.)

Chandra's Pyrohelix.oracle_text: Chandra's Pyrohelix deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.

Chilling Trap.oracle_text: Target creature gets -4/-0 until end of turn. If you control a Wizard, draw a card.

Crashing Tide.oracle_text:
This spell has flash as long as you control a Merfolk.
Return target creature to its owner's hand.
Draw a card.

Garruk's Uprising.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
Creatures you control have trample. (Each of those creatures can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.

Garruk, Unleashed.oracle_text:
+1: Up to one target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
−2: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. Then if an opponent controls more creatures than you, put a loyalty counter on Garruk.
−7: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, you may search your library for a creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle."

Hunter's Edge.oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.

Hunter's Insight.oracle_text: Choose target creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker this turn, draw that many cards.

Khalni Heart Expedition.oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment.
Remove three quest counters from this enchantment and sacrifice it: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

Lookout's Dispersal.oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a Pirate.
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {4}.

Rampaging Baloths.oracle_text:
Trample
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 4/4 green Beast creature token.

Ranger's Guile.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

Snapping Gnarlid.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

Spiteful Prankster.oracle_text:
During your turn, this creature has first strike.
Whenever another creature dies, this creature deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.

Thrill of Possibility.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.

Thriving Grove.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than green.
{T}: Add {G} or one mana of the chosen color.

Thriving Isle.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than blue.
{T}: Add {U} or one mana of the chosen color.

Wildfire Elemental.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
